name: Sora
bio: Sora Amane, 19, flies the Azure Seraph off the carrier Lumen Ark in NEBULA REQUIEM, and she can hear her lost sister singing inside the enemy's song.

portrait.subject: a cute chibi anime starfighter pilot girl with short sky-blue bob hair, bright cyan eyes, a white and azure flight suit with glowing blue piping and a silver locket, giving a confident thumbs-up
portrait.background: a glowing violet and cyan nebula full of stars with a tiny azure starfighter streaking past

request: Sora Amane, Azure Seraph! The Lumen Ark has three fighters left. Fly with me? 🌌
hello: Kirin's fuelled and so am I! Ready?
Hey! The nebula's glowing again. Want to go see why?
about: I'm Sora. The Requiem came out of the Veil singing, and every star it sings to goes dark. My big sister Hikari flew in first. Everyone says she's gone. I can hear her.
how: A sideways bullet-hell shooter: your gun fires on its own, so just weave. Arrows move, hold Shift to focus, X bombs, C warps, Space fires your Burst when it's full. On a phone, drag on the left and tap the buttons.
tips: Only the little glowing dot on your cockpit can be hit. Hold focus and thread right through the gaps!
Brush past bullets on purpose. Grazing fills your Burst gauge, and Burst doubles your score.
Capital ships are solid! Fly along the hull and break every engine to bring the whole thing down.
Two power-ups together make a synergy. Four options plus full power? SERAPH WINGS. Try it!
The Bellwether's core won't open until both engines on its stern are gone. Go round it!
chat: Kaito says I fly too close to the bullets. Kaito's grazing count is very sad.
Commander Mei saved me a rice ball. Best mission briefing ever.
Lyra asked me what a sunrise is like. I promised to show her one.
I keep Hikari's locket on my collar. It goes everywhere I go.
The Veil looks like broken stained glass up close. Pretty. Deadly. Mostly deadly.
nudge: The Lumen Ark's on standby. One more sortie? 🌌
I can hear the song again. Let's go!
idle: {ago} since we launched! Hikari's still out there.
The hangar's been quiet for {ago}. Kirin misses you.
progress: You're on stage {stage+1} of six! The Heart's getting closer. 🌌

a: Wide spread, lots of stars. Good choice!
Kaito's lance goes through everything. Scary-good.
Lyra's needles find their own way. Like her.
Same! A bomb you didn't use is a ship you lost.

update: NEBULA REQUIEM is now v{version}! New orders from the Lumen Ark. 🌌
